messages:
Adele (Finance): Morning team — found an issue: customer NimbusAI got two invoices. One lacks the reserved_capacity credit (-$4,200) and totals differ: $28,400 vs $24,200.
Rory (Billing): I see invoice ids 2026-07-NA-0301 and 2026-07-NA-0301-dup in the ledger. Both have same invoice_id value but different line items.
InvoiceBot: job=invoice.batch run=1799000000 status=partial_fail duplicates=1 missing_lines=1 artifact=/tmp/nimbusai_diff_179900.csv
Sofia (Billing-ops): We had a retry storm after a flaky DB transaction at 02:46. Looks like two workers published PDFs for the same invoice_id; one publish missed the credit row due to a stream abort.
Jun (Engineering): Reproduced locally. The compose pipeline emits line items then publishes; if the publish path retries it can re-emit without the tail credit row. I'll add an atomic publish/dedupe guard and a post-compose checksum to catch missing rows.
Rory (Billing): Can we recompose only NimbusAI? I want to void the bad PDF before customer sees it.
Jun (Engineering): Yes, using POST /internal/billing/recompose?account=nimbusai&run=1799000000 — started.
InvoiceBot: recompose job=1799005000 status=success artifact=/artifacts/BLG-6110/nimbusai_recompose_1799005000.csv
Sofia (Billing-ops): Voided 2026-07-NA-0301-dup and queued corrected invoice 2026-07-NA-0301-R1. Drafted credit memo for $4,200.
Adele (Finance): Approved credit memo. CC AE on customer comms and attach subscription-level breakdown.
Rory (Billing): Sent corrected invoice + credit memo to customer and AE. Ledger note LN-7719 added explaining root cause and action.
Jun (Engineering): Patch merged: atomic publish guard + checksum alert when line_count changes between compose and publish. Also added alert for duplicate_invoice_id > 0.
Adele (Finance): Closing loop — corrected invoice issued, duplicate voided, fix merged. Will reopen if customer escalates. :white_check_mark:
_meta: generated_for_dataset: finance invoice generation failures; concise Slack thread with bot logs, targeted recompose, and engineering remediation
